  • Adhere to rigorous quality standards in client feedback, forecasting, media buying decisions, and system execution.
  • Meet all deadlines and budget requirements, ensuring timely and on Target Performance.
  • Contribute valuable ideas to team discussions and company-wide content, supporting growth and innovation.

DOMAIN

MANAGEMENT

  • Your supervisor would be Joy Sharma, The Director of the CTC Accelerator Program.
  • You’ll report directly to Joy Sharma —a leader known for his relentless pursuit of excellence and an unmatched passion for growth strategy. Joy is a rare mentor, often described as the closest you’ll come to learning directly from Taylor Holiday himself. With a career built on his own rigorous, self-driven learning, Joy has transformed numerous team members into top-tier strategists, instilling in them the values of dedication, precision, and continuous improvement.

Working under Joy's guidance will push you to your limits in the best possible way. He models the value of hard work, and learning from him feels like “drinking from a firehose”—you’ll absorb knowledge quickly and consistently, experiencing tremendous growth. Joy is committed to personally ensuring you reach your full potential as a Senior Ecommerce Growth Strategist, supporting your journey every step of the way.

ORIENTATION

  • This role will be client-facing.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR ME?

SALARY RANGE

  • First month: $2,000
  • Second month: $4,000
  • Third month (on average): $7,000 a month
  • 1st Year Annual Range: $64,000-$76,000
  • 2nd Year Annual Range: $100,000-$120,000

This will depend on the amount of clients and the quality of work.

Growth, Transparency, and Fairness in Career Development

  • Progress is Clearly Defined
  • Depends primarily on your experience with the system & quality of execution against it. Following a well-defined path for the first 12 months and how exactly you can grow to be promoted to the next level.
  • Fairness and transparency are prioritized
  • Access a weekly performance dashboard to see exactly where you stand compared to team members on both objective and subjective metrics.
  • Pay transparency is upheld for all team members
  • With consistent contract terms and a clear roadmap for increasing earnings, ensuring everyone understands the path to greater compensation. We will also talk monthly about how you can progress.
  • My Commitment to You:
  • You will work harder, learn more than ever before, and “make more than you ever have.” You will gain a diverse skill set while actively contributing to the continuous development of new tools and improvements within our system. In doing so you will have an incredible opportunity for rapid career progression.
  • We will continue to provide you mentorship through every step of your development in the role and promotion from it. We will then continue to provide feedback against the expectation and evaluate against it.
  • Fully remote with the ability to pick your schedule.
  • Embrace autonomy as a core value, with clear expectations, regular 1:1 feedback sessions, and measurable quality benchmarks to support personal growth. Exceptional work is recognized and rewarded, with weekly check-ins for accountability, ensuring you’re consistently challenged and engaged with new opportunities daily.

description:
Você gosta de startups? Tem interesse em computação em nuvem? Temos uma posição para você.
As startups são as grandes empresas do futuro. Estas jovens empresas são fundadas por pessoas ambiciosas que desejam construir algo significativo e desafiar o status quo seja para atender novos clientes ou para desafiar os atuais. Geralmente operam em um ambiente de escassez: seja de capital, recursos de engenharia ou experiência. É aqui que você entra.
A equipe de arquitetura de soluções de inicialização da AWS se dedica a trabalhar com essas empresas que estão em estágio inicial à medida que elas constroem seus negócios. Estamos aqui para garantir que eles possam implantar as melhores, mais escaláveis e mais seguras arquiteturas possíveis – e que gastem o mínimo de tempo e dinheiro possível fazendo isso.
Procuramos construtoras técnicas que amam a ideia de trabalhar com startups em estágio inicial para ajudá-las à medida que crescem. Nesta função, você trabalhará diretamente com clientes interessantes e os ajudará a tomar as melhores (e às vezes mais pragmáticas) decisões técnicas ao longo do caminho. Você terá a oportunidade de construir relacionamentos duradouros com essas empresas e se estabelecer como um consultor confiável.
Temos mais de 200 serviços em diversas categorias diferentes e é importante que possamos ajudar as startups a aproveitar as vantagens dos serviços certos. Você também desempenhará um papel importante como defensora de nossas equipes de produtos para garantir que estamos construindo os produtos certos para as startups com as quais você trabalha. E para os clientes com os quais você não trabalha individualmente, terá a oportunidade de compartilhar seu conhecimento de forma mais ampla, trabalhando em conteúdo técnico e apresentando-se em eventos.

Key job responsibilities
- Envolver-se diretamente com pessoas clientes iniciantes para fornecer-lhes apoio técnico à medida que constroem seus produtos na nuvem. Certifique-se de que eles estão gastando o mínimo de tempo e dinheiro possível fazendo isso;
- Criar planos, em conjunto com outros membros das equipes de contas do cliente, para definir como você ajudará as pessoas clientes com suas necessidades de nuvem;
- Compartilhar amplamente seu conhecimento técnico participando de sessões selecionadas, focadas em startups, com uma pessoa e em grupos maiores de clientes;
- Trabalhar com outras equipes na AWS (por exemplo, marketing, treinamento) para contribuir para a criação de conteúdo que possa ser entregue à comunidade mais ampla de startups em escala (por exemplo, vídeos on-line e outros conteúdos digitais).
A day in the life
Como membro do líder mundial para este espaço empolgante e de crescimento rápido, você terá a oportunidade de ajudar a impulsionar o crescimento e moldar o futuro de uma categoria de serviço que terá um impacto significativo em nossos clientes de modelo global de computação. Nossa equipe valoriza muito o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional. Não se trata de quantas horas você passa em casa ou no trabalho: é sobre o fluxo que você estabelece que traz energia para ambas as partes da sua vida. Acreditamos que encontrar o equilíbrio certo entre sua vida pessoal e profissional seja fundamental para a felicidade e a realização ao longo da vida. Oferecemos flexibilidade no horário de trabalho e encorajamos você a encontrar seu próprio equilíbrio entre o trabalho e a vida pessoal.
About the team
Aqui na AWS, abraçamos nossas diferenças. Estamos empenhados em promover nossa cultura de inclusão. Temos dez grupos de afinidade liderados por funcionários, alcançando 40.000 funcionários em mais de 190 capítulos globalmente. Temos ofertas de benefícios inovadores e hospedamos experiências de aprendizado anuais e contínuas, incluindo nossas conferências Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) e AmazeCon (diversidade de gênero). A cultura de inclusão da Amazon é reforçada em nossos 16 Princípios de Liderança, que lembram os membros da equipe a buscarem diversas perspectivas, aprenderem e serem curiosos e ganharem confiança.
About the team
Experiências Diversas
A AWS valoriza experiências diversas. Mesmo que você não atenda a todas as qualificações e habilidades preferenciais listadas na descrição do cargo, incentivamos os candidatos a se candidatarem. Se sua carreira está apenas começando, não seguiu um caminho tradicional ou inclui experiências alternativas, não deixe que isso o impeça de se candidatar.
Por que a AWS?
A Amazon Web Services (AWS) é a plataforma de nuvem mais abrangente e amplamente adotada do mundo. Fomos pioneiros na computação em nuvem e nunca paramos de inovar — é por isso que os clientes, desde as startups mais bem-sucedidas até as empresas da Global 500, confiam em nosso robusto conjunto de produtos e serviços para impulsionar seus negócios.
Cultura de Equipe Inclusiva
Aqui na AWS, está em nossa natureza aprender e ser curiosos. Nossos grupos de afinidade liderados por funcionários promovem uma cultura de inclusão que nos permite ter orgulho de nossas diferenças. Eventos e experiências de aprendizado contínuos nos inspiram a nunca parar de abraçar nossa singularidade.
Mentoria e Crescimento Profissional
Estamos continuamente elevando nosso padrão de desempenho enquanto nos esforçamos para nos tornar o Melhor Empregador da Terra. É por isso que você encontrará aqui compartilhamento de conhecimento sem fim, mentoria e outros recursos para o avanço da carreira para ajudá-lo a se desenvolver como um profissional mais completo.
Equilíbrio entre Trabalho e Vida Pessoal
Valorizamos a harmonia entre trabalho e vida pessoal. Alcançar o sucesso no trabalho nunca deve vir às custas de sacrifícios em casa, por isso buscamos flexibilidade como parte de nossa cultura de trabalho. Quando nos sentimos apoiados no local de trabalho e em casa, não há nada que não possamos alcançar.

  • Colaborar com os times de produto e desenvolvimento para garantir que os problemas dos clientes sejam solucionados de maneira eficiente e definitiva, dentro dos níveis de serviço acordados.

Resolução de incidentes críticos:

Educação e gerenciamento de problemas nas integrações de APIs:

description:
Overview

Location: Brazil • Job Mode: Full-time • Work Mode: Work from home

We are seeking an experienced Oracle Integration Cloud Senior Engineer with strong expertise in Oracle VBCS to design, develop, and maintain cloud-based integrations and front-end applications across Oracle SaaS. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of Oracle Fusion Cloud, REST / SOAP APIs, and low-code application development using VBCS. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing integration solutions that connect various applications and services, ensuring seamless data flow and process automation.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Drive integration best practices and use of OIC with a high level of understanding of Oracle solutions to drive integrations and the architecture of business-critical operations and technical dependencies
  • Implement architected structures, including Oracle systems and tools, such as VBCS, APEX, Fusion, ERP, and other solutions
  • Create and configure connections, lookup tables, and scheduled orchestrations
  • Develop BIP reports, extract data using Oracle BI Publisher and OTBI reports, and consume them in OIC and VBCS
  • Develop ORDS APIs for the data stored in the ATP database API’s
  • Develop conversions using FBDI process
  • Develop and implement workflows, APIs, and data mapping using OIC and associated tools and / or systems
  • Monitor and maintain integration flows, handle errors, and perform root cause analysis
  • Ensure integration complies with company policies, industry standards, and security best practices
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, analyze existing systems, and recommend solutions and forward-looking and scalable strategies
  • Collaborate with quality teams to monitor and troubleshoot integration processes to ensure high availability and performance
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers and team members
  • Stay up-to-date with Oracle technologies and industry trends to recommend leading practices and enhancements
  • Document integration processes, architectural designs, and technical specifications
  • Ensure compliance with security standards and best practices in all integration activities
  • Drive the overall team’s success by embracing the cultural beliefs and encouraging the team towards continuous improvement
  • Remain agile to adapt to a fast-paced environment and to quickly adjust to the market demands
  • Ensure Software Engineering best practices are documented and followed by the engineering team

Essential Skills

  • Experience as an Oracle Integration Cloud Developer or similar role
  • Proficiency in Oracle Integration Cloud, including Process, Connections, and Integration Design and implementation, with knowledge of events / applications and when / how to utilize
  • Hands on with building VBCS pages, BIP, and OTBI Reports
  • Conversions using FBDI process
  • Strong knowledge of Fusion, Apex, ERP, and other Oracle Technologies
  • Good understanding of OCI resources
  • Proficient knowledge of SDLC, including algorithms / strategies of scaled enterprise systems as well as individual applications
  • Experience with RESTful and SOAP web services, API management, business events, and application composer data transformation
  • Strong experience with Oracle databases and SQL
  • Strong understanding of cloud integration concepts, disaster recovery, security standards, quality, and compliance

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Oracle Cloud certifications (e.g., Oracle Integration Cloud Certification)
  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies
  • Engineering, IT, and / or Web Application experience

With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.

Location: Remote

We’re building a virtual office platform for remote and hybrid teams. It brings together persistent rooms, real-time presence, audio / video (WebRTC), chat, screen sharing, collaborative boards, and immersive spaces to boost connection, productivity, and team cohesion — all in one place.

We’re seeking a hands-on Senior Product Owner who owns the product end-to-end (discovery → definition → delivery → post-launch) and acts as the daily bridge between stakeholders and developers. Beyond roadmap and prioritization, you will test the product, hunt bugs, propose improvements, and run competitor research to turn insights into shipped value.

What You’ll Do

  • Daily communication (English): Lead daily standups in English with developers and stakeholders; drive alignment, clarify scope, and ensure follow-through to delivery.
  • Backlog & delivery ownership: Plan OKRs / roadmap; break initiatives into epics / stories; manage risks, dependencies, timelines, and quality.
  • Jira & Confluence discipline (non-negotiable):
  • Keep Jira 100% accurate (statuses, owners, dates, links).
  • Create extremely well-documented tickets: clear problem statement, context, scope / out-of-scope, acceptance criteria, functional & non-functional requirements, edge cases, steps to reproduce, logs / screens, links to Figma and related docs.
  • Enforce Definition of Ready / Done and maintain Confluence specs / decisions up to date. (Developers should never complain about unclear tickets again.)
  • Ensure planned dates for Stage and Production are set on relevant Jira issues and reflected in views / boards.
  • Discovery & definition: User interviews, usability tests, JTBD mapping; author PRDs / specs with crisp acceptance criteria.
  • Quality & testing: Perform exploratory testing, reproduce issues, triage, and file actionable bug cards.
  • Continuous improvement: Track activation / engagement / retention, run A / B experiments, and prioritize UX / performance / stability improvements.
  • Competitor research: Benchmark features / flows and translate findings into opportunities and prioritization.

Reporting & rituals

  • Daily stakeholder report (every business day) consolidating, per developer:
  • What was completed today.
  • The current task and ETA for completion.
  • The next 3 tasks with planned start / end dates.
  • Tasks that moved to Stage today (and which developer).
  • Tasks that moved to Production today (and which developer).
  • Mirror this view in Jira dashboards / filters with Stage / Prod target dates visible.
  • Maintain AI-generated minutes of every daily with summaries stored in Jira (and linked in Confluence).
  • Friday report includes the weekly summary and the monthly developer performance evaluation when applicable.

Must-Haves

  • 5+ years in Product Ownership / Product Management (senior) with a track record of shipping and iterating successfully.
  • Fluent English — capable of leading daily standups in English, writing specs, and aligning requirements with international stakeholders.
  • Software development experience (prior engineering role strongly preferred) or equivalent technical background — comfortable discussing architecture, APIs, data models, and reading code / PRs at a high level.
  • Proven follow-through : nothing falls through the cracks; you drive clarity to outcomes.
  • Tooling (required): Jira, Confluence, Figma, Slack, Google Sheets.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to WebRTC / AV concepts, performance tuning, or growth loops.
  • Certifications: CSPO, Pragmatic, Agile.

title: Product Specialist
description:
Overview

Lucidworks is leading digital transformation for some of the world\'s biggest retailers, financial services firms, manufacturers, and B2B commerce organizations. We believe that the core to a great digital experience starts with search and browse. Our Deep Learning technology captures user behavior and utilizes machine learning to connect people with the products, content, and information they need. Brands including American Airlines, Lenovo, Red Hat, and Cisco Systems rely on Lucidworks\' suite of products to power commerce, customer service, and workplace applications that delight customers and empower employees. Lucidworks believes in the power of diversity and inclusion to help us do our best work. We are an Equal Opportunity employer and welcome talent across a full range of backgrounds, orientation, origin, and identity in an inclusive and non-discriminatory way.

About the Role

We are seeking a Product Specialist who will be responsible for developing materials and frameworks that translate product strategy and roadmap into clear, actionable insights for our customer-facing teams. This role sits at the intersection of product management, strategy, and customer engagement. You will bring our product vision to life by creating buyer personas, value propositions, and supporting collateral that articulate how our products solve real customer challenges.

The Product Specialist will shape the narrative around our product strategy, while driving operational consistency by creating frameworks, processes, and repeatable assets that keep product direction aligned with field execution. This role will work closely with product leadership, sales, and customer success teams to ensure our products are well-understood and properly represented in conversations with prospects and customers. The ideal candidate has a strategic mindset, strong storytelling skills, and the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for diverse audiences.

To ensure fairness and efficiency, we kindly ask that all interest in this role be

submitted through the application link rather than direct outreach.

Responsibilities

  • Develop a deep understanding of the product portfolio, market trends, competitive landscape, and customer needs.
  • Translate product strategy and roadmap into personas, positioning frameworks, and value propositions tailored to different buyer and user segments.
  • Partner with product managers to inform roadmap decisions with customer and market insights.
  • Collaborate with sales and customer-facing teams to ensure consistent and compelling communication of product value.
  • Create product-related resources such as presentations, customer-facing briefs, solution guides, and sales playbooks.
  • Standardize processes for how roadmap and strategy updates are captured, documented, and shared.
  • Deliver training and briefings to internal teams, ensuring alignment on product capabilities, differentiators, and release milestones.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert to support conversations with prospects, customers, and industry analysts.
  • Support go-to-market planning for launches by aligning internal readiness materials with product release timelines.
  • All other duties as assigned.

Skills & Qualifications

  • Minimum of 4 years of experience in a B2B software role
  • Strong critical thinking skills with the ability to assess market opportunities and customer requirements.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling abilities, with experience creating content for both business and technical audiences.
  • Experience building buyer personas and messaging frameworks that resonate with target segments.
  • Demonstrated ability to take complex concepts and distill them into simple, compelling narratives.
  • Comfortable working across teams and influencing stakeholders in a matrixed environment.
  • Bachelor\'s degree in business, communications, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

Competencies

  • Resourceful: able to proactively discover solutions, learn quickly, and adapt in ambiguous environments.
  • Collaborative: works well across teams and geographies, with empathy and inclusivity.
  • Organized and detail-oriented: comfortable managing dependencies and backlog grooming.
  • Customer-obsessed: listens deeply to user pain points and translates them into impactful product features.
  • Ability to handle confidential information

$100,000 - $137,000 a year

This salary range may include multiple levels. Your level is based on our assessment of your interview performance and experience, which you can always ask the hiring manager about to understand in more detail. Your total rewards package may include (but is not necessarily limited to) discretionary variable bonus, top-notch medical, dental and vision coverage, equity, a variety of voluntary benefits, flexible time off, various leave policies, and many other region-specific benefits.

Lucidworks believes in the power of diversity and inclusion to help us do our best work. We are an Equal Opportunity employer and welcome talent across a full range of backgrounds, orientation, origin, and identity in an inclusive and non-discriminatory way. Applicants receive consideration based on the relevant talents, skills, and experiences they offer to our company.

Thank you for your interest and we look forward to learning more about you.

Note to third party recruiters:

We appreciate your interest in our job opportunities. However, we kindly request that third-party recruiters and staffing agencies refrain from contacting us regarding these positions. We prefer to work directly with candidates and do not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate referrals from third-party recruiters or agencies. Overview

O que é a nstech?

A nstech é a mais completa plataforma open logistics do mundo, construindo o futuro digital do transporte de cargas junto a todo o ecossistema logístico. Nosso objetivo é conectar e transformar a cadeia logística, oferecendo centenas de soluções integradas em um único lugar. Estamos em busca de profissionais apaixonados e determinados para se juntarem a nós como Analista de Operações de Marketplace . Se você tem vontade de aprender, transformar a logística e mobilidade e fazer a diferença, essa é a sua oportunidade!

Na nstech, temos uma cultura baseada em valores e esperamos que todos os nstechers não apenas se identifiquem, mas também vivam essa cultura em seu dia a dia. Acreditamos que a cultura é uma das maiores vantagens competitivas para negócios bem-sucedidos, pois é algo que não pode ser copiado integralmente.

Temos a visão de ser a plataforma de tecnologia para logística e mobilidade que conecta os elos e gera mais valor para os negócios da rede integrada de logística da América Latina. Atualmente, contamos com uma equipe de mais de 3500 nstechers comprometidos em melhorar o mundo por meio da tecnologia aplicada à logística e mobilidade. Estamos empenhados em gerar impacto para a sociedade, clientes, colaboradores e acionistas, e queremos somar forças com pessoas cheias de energia e propósito para fazer parte de nossa equipe e dessa transformação. Além disso:

Infobel Pro is a leading provider of large-scale B2B, Point of Interest (POI), and B2C data. As we continue to expand, we are looking for a technically adept and commercially-minded Sales Engineer to join our team and serve as a crucial link between our powerful data products and our clients’ business needs.

As a Data Sales Engineer, you will be a key player in our sales process, acting as the primary technical resource for our sales team and a trusted advisor to our prospective clients.   • A strong technical background, ideally from a STEM field or equivalent practical experience.
  • Proficiency in SQL for data manipulation and analysis, with experience handling large datasets. Experience with tools like DuckDB is a plus.
  • Good command of Python for scripting, data processing, and interacting with APIs.
  • Good communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
  • A business-oriented mindset, with the ability to connect technical features to business value. Experience in a client-facing role (e.g., consulting, sales engineering) is highly desirable.
  • A proactive, problem-solving attitude and the ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

What We Offer

  • Competitive pay

  • Remote work environment

In order to successfully perform the essential functions of this job the employee must be able to verbally communicate with employees, co-workers and customers online and by phone.

title: Senior Product Owner
description:
Senior Product Owner

Location: Remote

Contract: PJ (full-time)

Level: Senior

We’re building a virtual office platform for remote and hybrid teams. It brings together persistent rooms, real-time presence, audio / video (WebRTC), chat, screen sharing, collaborative boards, and immersive spaces to boost connection, productivity, and team cohesion — all in one place.

We’re seeking a hands-on Senior Product Owner who owns the product end-to-end (discovery → definition → delivery → post-launch) and acts as the daily bridge between stakeholders and developers. Beyond roadmap and prioritization, you will test the product, hunt bugs, propose improvements, and run competitor research to turn insights into shipped value.

What You’ll Do

  • Daily communication (English): Lead daily standups in English with developers and stakeholders; drive alignment, clarify scope, and ensure follow-through to delivery.
  • Backlog & delivery ownership: Plan OKRs / roadmap; break initiatives into epics / stories; manage risks, dependencies, timelines, and quality.
  • Jira & Confluence discipline (non-negotiable):
  • Keep Jira 100% accurate (statuses, owners, dates, links).
  • Create extremely well-documented tickets: clear problem statement, context, scope / out-of-scope, acceptance criteria, functional & non-functional requirements, edge cases, steps to reproduce, logs / screens, links to Figma and related docs.
  • Enforce Definition of Ready / Done and maintain Confluence specs / decisions up to date. (Developers should never complain about unclear tickets again.)
  • Ensure planned dates for Stage and Production are set on relevant Jira issues and reflected in views / boards.
  • Discovery & definition: User interviews, usability tests, JTBD mapping; author PRDs / specs with crisp acceptance criteria.
  • Quality & testing: Perform exploratory testing, reproduce issues, triage, and file actionable bug cards.
  • Continuous improvement: Track activation / engagement / retention, run A / B experiments, and prioritize UX / performance / stability improvements.
  • Competitor research: Benchmark features / flows and translate findings into opportunities and prioritization.

Reporting & rituals

  • Daily stakeholder report (every business day) consolidating, per developer:
  • What was completed today.
  • The current task and ETA for completion.
  • The next 3 tasks with planned start / end dates.
  • Tasks that moved to Stage today (and which developer).
  • Tasks that moved to Production today (and which developer).
  • Mirror this view in Jira dashboards / filters with Stage / Prod target dates visible.
  • Maintain AI-generated minutes of every daily with summaries stored in Jira (and linked in Confluence).
  • Friday report includes the weekly summary and the monthly developer performance evaluation when applicable.

Must-Haves

  • 5+ years in Product Ownership / Product Management (senior) with a track record of shipping and iterating successfully.
  • Fluent English — capable of leading daily standups in English, writing specs, and aligning requirements with international stakeholders.
  • Software development experience (prior engineering role strongly preferred) or equivalent technical background — comfortable discussing architecture, APIs, data models, and reading code / PRs at a high level.
  • Proven follow-through: nothing falls through the cracks; you drive clarity to outcomes.
  • Tooling (required): Jira, Confluence, Figma, Slack, Google Sheets.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to WebRTC / A/V concepts, performance tuning, or growth loops.
  • Certifications: CSPO, Pragmatic, Agile.

About Infobel Pro

Infobel Pro is a leading provider of large-scale B2B, Point of Interest (POI), and B2C data. We empower businesses globally with comprehensive, accurate, and actionable data to drive their sales, marketing, and analytical efforts. As we continue to expand, we are looking for a technically adept and commercially-minded Sales Engineer to join our team and serve as a crucial link between our powerful data products and our clients’ business needs.

The Role

As a Data Sales Engineer, you will be a key player in our sales process, acting as the primary technical resource for our sales team and a trusted advisor to our prospective clients. You will be responsible for understanding the complex data challenges of our prospects and demonstrating how Infobel Pro’s solutions can solve them. This role is perfect for someone with a strong technical background, a passion for data, and a consultative, business-oriented mindset.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Pre-Sales Support: Collaborate with the sales team to understand prospect requirements and articulate the technical and business value of our data solutions.

  • Product Expertise: Serve as the subject matter expert on Infobel Pro’s data offerings. You will be expected to explain our data products and enrichment processes at a deep technical level to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Solution Design: Work with clients to design and propose data solutions that meet their specific needs, ensuring they derive maximum value from our products.
  • Client Communication: Build strong relationships with prospects by providing expert guidance, answering technical questions, and ensuring a smooth pre-sales experience.

What You Bring

  • A strong technical background, ideally from a STEM field or equivalent practical experience.
  • Proficiency in SQL for data manipulation and analysis, with experience handling large datasets. Experience with tools like DuckDB is a plus.
  • Good command of Python for scripting, data processing, and interacting with APIs.
  • Good communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
  • A business-oriented mindset, with the ability to connect technical features to business value. Experience in a client-facing role (e.g., consulting, sales engineering) is highly desirable.
  • A proactive, problem-solving attitude and the ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

What We Offer

  • A growing company with a strong vision
  • Competitive pay
  • Commission structure
  • Supportive team culture focused on learning, ownership, and impact
  • Remote work environment
  • Exposure to global customers and a wide variety of data use cases

Abilities and Other Requirements

In order to successfully perform the essential functions of this job the employee must be able to verbally communicate with employees, co-workers and customers online and by phone.

Overview

Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.

More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it’s because they are employed by a company that doesn’t offer a retirement plan. Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.

We’re a high-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors. This includes funding from Marshall Wace and Baillie Gifford, as well as top investors such as BlackRock, TPG (The Rise Fund), SoftBank, Glynn Capital, NewView Capital, USVP, Wing, Uncork, and more.

About the role

Our Partnership Program is a key initiative for the company. The Partner Account Manager’s primary duty is to engage, build and develop Human Interest’s key accounts and growth opportunities. We are looking for a forward-thinking, meticulously organized, and self-motivated sales professional who can thrive in a fast-paced environment. You will accelerate our partner relationships to help us exponentially reach more small and medium businesses across the United States, which is essential to our growth. This role requires someone who is proactive, creative, and can exercise their own discretion and judgment to create their own solutions when needed.

  • Create and build strategic referral networks and partnerships focused on lead generation and new partnership opportunities

What you bring to the role

  • Successful - Proven track record of success in a quota driven sales environment

title: Inside Sales Specialist
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a motivated and detail oriented Inside Sales Specialist to join our Life Sciences sales team. This role is critical in driving revenue growth across Crown Bioscience's full portfolio of pre-clinical and translational oncology services, including organoids, in vivo and in vitro models, biomarker discovery, human biospecimens, and integrated drug discovery solutions.

The Inside Sales Specialist will develop strong client relationships, manage the inside sales cycle, and support business development initiatives with biotech, pharma, and academic researchers worldwide. By promoting Crown Bioscience's world-leading preclinical platforms, cancer databases, and precision oncology offerings, this role ensures scientists have the tools they need to accelerate discoveries in cancer diagnostics and therapeutics.

Importantly, the Inside Sales Specialist will work with Prendio, a third-party procurement platform for the biotech industry, to help generate biotech leads, manage referrals from their preferred supplier network, and strengthen the partnership relationship.

Key Responsibilities

  • Sales & Business Development
    • Proactively identify, qualify, and manage inbound and outbound sales opportunities across Crown Bioscience's full portfolio (organoids, in vivo/in vitro models, biomarkers, human biospecimens, etc.).
    • Manage the full inside sales cycle: lead generation, prospect engagement, needs assessment, quoting, negotiation, and closing.
    • Collaborate with SDRs and field-based Business Development Directors to support client acquisition, account expansion, and long-term growth.
    • Serve as the primary inside sales contact for Prendio-generated biotech leads.
    • Consistently achieve and exceed assigned sales targets, contributing directly to company revenue goals.
  • Customer Engagement
    • Serve as the first point of contact for researchers, biotech, pharma, and CRO clients seeking preclinical and translational oncology solutions.
    • Build strong, trust-based relationships by understanding client needs and recommending tailored Crown Bioscience offerings.
    • Deliver accurate and timely information regarding service capabilities, project feasibility, and proposal details.
    • Provide outstanding customer service throughout the sales cycle, ensuring client satisfaction and repeat business.
  • Operational & Cross-Functional Collaboration
    • Partner with operations, scientific, and project management teams to ensure feasibility, accuracy, and timely delivery of client projects.
    • Maintain detailed records of client interactions, pipeline activity, and forecasts within the CRM system.
    • Share market and customer feedback with internal stakeholders to help refine and expand service offerings.
    • Collaborate closely with external partners like Prendio to maximize lead generation opportunities and strengthen biotech outreach.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Business, or related field.
  • 2+ years of experience in inside sales, customer success, or business development in life sciences, biotechnology, or CRO sectors.
  • Strong communication, relationship-building, and presentation skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to consistently meet or exceed sales targets.
  • Highly organized with attention to detail and experience using CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot).
  • Self-motivated team player with a proactive approach and passion for supporting oncology research.

Preferred Requirements

  • Advanced degree (MSc, MBA, or equivalent) in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or related field.
  • 3+ years of inside sales or business development experience in oncology or precision medicine services.
  • Strong understanding of preclinical workflows (organoids, in vivo/in vitro models, biomarkers, biospecimens).
  • Experience working with or managing leads from third-party platforms (e.g., procurement networks such as Prendio).
  • Background in supporting biotech, pharma, or CRO clients with complex research needs.

Salary Range: $70,000 - $90,000

This salary (or salary range) is merely an estimate and may vary based on an applicant's skills and prior relevant experience.

Crown Bioscience is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Crown Bioscience is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

Senior Salesforce Developer – role focus

As a Senior Salesforce Developer, you will serve as a subject matter expert for Salesforce development, drive architectural decisions within the platform, and mentor team members across multiple cross-functional projects. You will collaborate closely with business analysts, product owners, and external vendors to ensure the Salesforce ecosystem supports strategic business objectives.

Salesforce Development & Customization.

  • Extend standard Salesforce functionality through robust custom development and configuration.
  • Maintain clean, scalable, and well-documented code that adheres to Salesforce best practices.

Platform Architecture & Integration.

  • Design scalable and secure Salesforce architecture, aligning with business goals and system performance requirements.
  • Integrate Salesforce with external systems (e.g., ERP, billing, or internal data platforms) using REST APIs, middleware, or third-party tools.

  • Work closely with business and product managers to gather and interpret functional and technical requirements.
  • Translate requirements into actionable technical designs and scalable implementations.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to planning, estimation, and sprint reviews.
  • Conduct code reviews and technical design reviews to ensure quality and consistency.
  • Share expertise on Salesforce releases, platform changes, and new development approaches.
  • Implement unit tests, integration tests, and participate in UAT to ensure robust solutions.
  • Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and Salesforce features to recommend enhancements and optimizations to existing implementations.

title: Senior Flutter Developer
description:
Overview

Senior Flutter Developer

Location: Remote

Contract: PJ (full-time)

Level: Senior

We’re building a virtual office platform for remote and hybrid teams. It brings together persistent rooms, real-time presence, audio / video (WebRTC), chat, screen sharing, collaborative boards, and immersive spaces to boost connection, productivity, and team cohesion — all in one place.

The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Flutter Developer focused on macOS Desktop to build and evolve our desktop client. You’ll ship a high-performance, stable, and well-instrumented app that integrates video / audio, real-time features, and collaborative tools—while keeping top-tier code quality, testing, and documentation.

Secondary scope: help maintain Android and iOS builds (feature parity, fixes, and releases).

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain the Flutter macOS app with clean architecture, modular layers, and reliable state management.
  • Integrate RESTful APIs and real-time services (e.g., WebSockets / Streams).
  • Implement A / V features (e.g., flutter_webrtc): device selection, camera / mic permissions, I / O routing, and stability under variable networks.
  • Ensure observability end to end: instrument product events / metrics; triage errors with Sentry; capture UX signals with Microsoft Clarity (session replay / heatmaps) where applicable (web / embedded views); analyze performance traces and dashboards.
  • Own quality: unit, widget, and integration tests; CI checks; code reviews; technical docs.
  • Handle macOS distribution: code signing & notarization, entitlements, Hardened Runtime, App Sandbox, Keychain; package DMG / PKG; manage auto-update (e.g., Sparkle).
  • Collaborate with Product / Design / QA to refine requirements, edge cases, and acceptance criteria; keep specs tidy in Confluence and PRs clear.
  • Team rituals & reporting:
  • Attend daily standups in English and other ceremonies (planning, grooming, demos, retros).
  • Keep Jira up to date (status, links, attachments) and log time entries (work logs) per task.
  • Submit an end-of-day (EOD) daily report in English including: hours worked (per task), what was completed, current task & ETA, blockers, and plan for tomorrow.
  • Secondary (Android & iOS): maintain parity when applicable, fix platform-specific issues, help with CI / CD and store releases, monitor crashes / perf via Sentry and review UX insights with Clarity when relevant.

CPU & GPU Optimizations (primary focus)

  • Minimize rebuilds: effective state selection (BLoC / Riverpod / Provider), const constructors, proper Keys, split large widgets.
  • Cut redundant layout / work: avoid heavy logic in build, cache computed values, reduce intrinsic measurements, coalesce events, debounce / throttle streams.
  • Move heavy tasks off the UI thread: isolates (compute / custom), lazy JSON parsing, incremental work units.
  • Frame scheduling discipline: prevent setState loops; render only when state actually changes.
  • Reduce overdraw / repaints: place RepaintBoundary wisely; optimize CustomPainter (shouldRepaint); avoid large Opacity on complex subtrees.
  • Avoid expensive effects: minimize saveLayer, heavy blurs / gradients and big shadows.
  • Use right-sized images & filterQuality (low / none when acceptable); limit transforms on large layers.
  • Shader jank control: warm up shaders / capture SkSL where applicable; keep fragment shaders simple.
  • Pause / disable animations when off-screen; keep animation count / area minimal.

Measurement & Guardrails :

  • Profile with Flutter DevTools (CPU / GPU / frame timeline) and add perf budgets (avg CPU% / GPU frame time) to CI gates.
  • Track before / after metrics per feature; regressions must be fixed before release.

Must-Haves

  • Fluent English (spoken and written): comfortable in daily English standups and writing EOD reports.
  • Strong experience with Flutter and Dart building Desktop apps (preferably macOS).
  • Proven work reducing CPU / GPU usage in Flutter apps (ideally desktop / macOS) with measurable before / after results.
  • Solid grasp of architectural patterns (MVC / MVVM / Clean), DI, and state management (BLoC / Riverpod / Provider).
  • Hands-on with RESTful APIs, WebSockets / Streams, async / isolates, and robust error handling.
  • Firebase (Auth, Firestore, Analytics) or equivalent, Microsoft Clarity (for UX / session insights in web-embedded contexts), and Sentry for error / performance monitoring.
  • Git proficiency, code reviews, CI (e.g., GitHub Actions / GitLab CI), and Jira work logs / time tracking.

Nice to Have

  • Deep macOS expertise: signing, notarization, App Sandbox, entitlements, Keychain, packaging, and updater pipelines.
  • Practical WebRTC experience; spatial audio; jitter / latency tuning.
  • Android / iOS publishing (fastlane or equivalent), push notifications, and in-app review flows.
  • Docker, CDN, and networking basics for real-time apps.
  • Accessibility (VoiceOver / TalkBack) and internationalization.

Benefits & Environment

  • Remote-first, flexible hours, and competitive market range.
  • Fast feedback loops, ownership, and a product with real impact on how teams work every day.
  • Support for learning, events, and continuous improvement.

The company, which was set up in 1981 to help the nascent IT industry overcome its human resource challenges, today ranks among the world’s leading training companies owing to its vast, yet comprehensive array of talent development programs. With a footprint across 40 nations, NIIT offers training and development solutions to Individuals, Enterprises, and Institutions.

Role

Role : CSOD Partner Implementation Specialist. The role requires an ongoing engagement, based on demand and scheduling.

Job Title

Job Title : CSOD Partner Implementation Specialist

Location

Location : Remote

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced CSOD Partner Implementation Specialist certified in Cornerstone OnDemand (CSOD) to lead and complete implementations of the platform across its diverse modules, including Learning, Performance, Succession, Recruiting, LxP, Talent Link, MyGuide, and Talent Marketplace. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in implementing solutions for enterprise clients and a proven ability to integrate systems effectively. Experience with SABA or SumTotal is a bonus.

This role is not an administrative position but rather focuses on strategic implementation, integration, and enabling successful adoption of CSOD across industries.

Key Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Implementation: Lead the implementation process for CSOD modules, ensuring timely delivery and alignment with client requirements.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather, analyze, and define project objectives and outcomes.
  • Solution Design and Configuration: Configure CSOD solutions tailored to organizational needs, including Learning, Performance, Recruiting, and Succession.
  • Provide advisory on best practices for Talent Management and Employee Development.
  • Integration Expertise: Oversee 1-2 system integrations to ensure seamless data flow and operational efficiency.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve integration challenges with internal and external systems.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with functional leads from AMS, Accenture, AlephTalent, Banloe Consulting, CGI, Capgemini, Cognizant, DXC, Deloitte, IBM, Infosys, HCL Technologies, LRMG, Tata Consulting Services, Tier1 Performance, Atalent, TalearnX and other global organizations.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for implementation projects.
  • User Enablement: Ensure successful adoption of CSOD solutions through training sessions and user guides.
  • Work with MyGuide and Talent Marketplace modules to enhance user experience.
  • Cross-Platform Experience: Leverage knowledge of SABA or SumTotal as an added advantage for platform transitions or co-existence.

Qualifications

  • Certifications:
    • Cornerstone OnDemand Partner Implementation Certification is required.
    • Bonus: Certifications in SABA or SumTotal.
  • Experience:
    • 3-5 years of hands-on experience in implementing CSOD modules across Learning, Performance, and Talent solutions.
    • Experience with integrating HR / Talent platforms with other enterprise systems (1-2 integration projects required).
  • Technical Skills:
    • Proficiency in system configuration, user management, and workflow automation.
    • Knowledge of integration tools such as APIs, middleware, or proprietary connectors.
  • Soft Skills:
    • Strong communication and project management abilities.
    • Ability to collaborate across global teams and clients in different time zones.

NIIT is an equal-opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

About the project

At Nearsure, we know great talent doesn’t wait for job openings. That’s why we’re building a community of passionate professionals for future opportunities.

These proactive searches align with the profiles our trusted clients seek regularly. Join our "Future Talent" network to be among the first considered when the right opportunity arises.

With over 160 new hires every year, we are constantly expanding our team with passionate and skilled professionals who want to make an impact.

Senior Salesforce Developer — role and responsibilities

As a Senior Salesforce Developer , you will serve as a subject matter expert for Salesforce development, drive architectural decisions within the platform, and mentor team members across multiple cross-functional projects. You will collaborate closely with business analysts, product owners, and external vendors to ensure the Salesforce ecosystem supports strategic business objectives.

How your day-to-day work will look like :

Salesforce Development & Customization.

Design, develop, and implement custom solutions on the Salesforce platform using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, and Flows.

Extend standard Salesforce functionality through robust custom development and configuration.

Maintain clean, scalable, and well-documented code that adheres to Salesforce best practices.

Platform Architecture & Integration.

Design scalable and secure Salesforce architecture, aligning with business goals and system performance requirements.

Integrate Salesforce with external systems (e.g., ERP, billing, or internal data platforms) using REST APIs, middleware, or third-party tools.

Evaluate and recommend architectural enhancements or refactoring opportunities to improve platform performance and sustainability.

Work closely with business and product managers to gather and interpret functional and technical requirements.

Translate requirements into actionable technical designs and scalable implementations.

Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to planning, estimation, and sprint reviews.

Conduct code reviews and technical design reviews to ensure quality and consistency.

Share expertise on Salesforce releases, platform changes, and new development approaches.

Implement unit tests, integration tests, and participate in UAT to ensure robust solutions.

Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and Salesforce features to recommend enhancements and optimizations to existing implementations.

Provide training to development teams and end-users, ensuring they are well-equipped to effectively use and maintain Salesforce applications.

Keep current with the latest Salesforce platform features, AppExchange products, and development tools.

Identify and propose improvements to business processes and user experience through Salesforce.

Drive innovation by evaluating and adopting new Salesforce tools or design patterns.

This would make you the ideal candidate :

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

7+ Years of experience working on Salesforce development and platform customization.

Deep knowledge of Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and platform tools (Apex, LWC, Visualforce, Flows).

Experience with integrations (REST / SOAP APIs, middleware, Salesforce Connect, etc.).

Proficiency in version control and DevOps tools (Git, Copado, Gearset, or similar).

Hands-on experience with automation and release management best practices.

Advanced English Level is required for this role as you will work with US clients. Effective communication in English is essential to deliver the best solutions to our clients and expand your horizons.

Talent Connection process

  • Sign up : Apply to this position and upload your resume.
  • Profile review : Our team will review your profile and keep it in our talent database.
  • Contact : Our team will contact you to have an interview to get to know you better and to share with you a bit more of what we are looking for.
  • Knowing you better : We'd love to discuss your experience in an interview with our recruiters.
  • Notification : When a suitable position opens, we’ll contact you to start the selection process, having in mind that this process will be faster because we already had the first screening.
  • Transparency : This process is direct and without intermediaries.
